about: Bodies and clips, loaded at runtime from the OpenTrident library (never copied here). Bodies are the 106-joint MakeHuman set; clips are the library's per-clip GLBs (mixamorig bone names). Keys are the game's role names (Strategy 2026-10-25); values are clip ids picked by the OpenTrident Dev, to be checked on a body before they lock. `start` / `hit` = clip fractions where the swing starts and where it strikes, measured on mh-male-01 from the right hand's speed relative to the hips (start: first frame over 25 % of peak; hit: peak; the foot for Kick). The renderer maps the sim's wind-up onto start..hit (skipping the flat lead-in, V1's start offsets) and active+recovery onto hit..end.

bodySets.about: Dom 2026-10-25, the one-mold rule: V2 loads only bodies on the 106-joint rig. Every set names its rig; the validator fails CI on any set that isn't 106, and the loader refuses one too (falling back to the default). The MakeHuman pair wears its own armour layers; only its loose sword and scabbard are hidden. The default is Dom's pick (26 Oct): player Girlscout, opponent Kachujin, both OpenTrident's Mixamo bodies converted to 106 (V2 tab, models/custom). Both wear the same Layer_* armour meshes; only the loose sword and scabbard are hidden. ?body=makehuman loads the MakeHuman pair.

guardTilt.about: V1 characters.ts:434-437 GUARD_TILT: one Guard clip, the side shown by radians added after the mixer: torso yaw (spine_01 -> mixamorigSpine, y), sword-arm pitch (upperarm_r -> mixamorigRightArm, x), chest pitch (spine_02 -> mixamorigSpine1, x)

sword.about: The blade in the right hand: a library weapon (assets.json weapon-011, Half Sword long sword, 0.96 m). file is under the library base; grip = how far from the pommel end the hand sits (m); guard / tip = the trail's blade span, in the model's own metres along +Y (pommel -> tip). length / handle size the plain box shown until the model loads, or if it fails.
